spanish: Cinco las cortinas serán juntadas, mujer a su hermana, y cinco cortinas juntadas, mujer a su hermana.

findings.issue: Both qal active participles are rendered as the passive participle juntadas, so the curtains are joined instead of the ones that join.

notes: Five, the article only on the first curtains, the 3fp copula only in the first clause, and woman-to-her-sister twice match the tokens.
